author: blockman2803
body: Whats the best way to get better weapons for magic classes? Ive been using the same lich staff for like 30 levels

author: OMEGACorruption
body:
You are pretty good. I would say start to switch to a melee weapon if you want keep young the pet path since Melee is easier. If you want to stay as a magic based pet class, use another staff in your offhand. The scrolls aren't that good anymore compared and you lose the much ward compared just more magic that you can get from anothrr good staff in the same slot.

Also get used to ward and find a good shield instead of the double weapon/scroll/arrows combo

author: Allalilacias
body:
Your gear is good. Your naming sense impolute. Magnificent.

Only issue I see is the masterforging. I plan on doing it myself to items of that tier eventually, but only because I got them later on and I like them personally.

I'd wait on the masterforging until T7 or T8.

Actually, I don't know how you got time to do it. I went past that tier before I managed to get any gear to level 10.

As for how to go from this point, it depends much on what path you want to go and what luck you have. I'm impressed you have so many ornates, normally you don't get too many until higher tiers when the time between them allows you to farm more. But I'm a pure mage, so I wouldn't be able to help you on a pet class path.

I'd recommend shabbash, but I'm sure you already know of him.
